Package pokemonjavaedition

Class Player

java.lang.Object
pokemonjavaedition.Player
public class Player extends Object
It sets up all the characteristics that a player has when playing a pokémon game, such as his pokémon squad, his nickname in the game, the choice that he make in a turn, ecc... See its methods for more info.
Author:
dan

  • Method Details

    • getPokemonSquad

      public Pokemon[] getPokemonSquad()
      Gets the pokemonSquad that the player currently has.
      Returns:
      the array pokemonSquad. If no pokémon has been set in the array it will still return the array but all the pokemon created inside won't have any information set.

    • getPokemon

      public Pokemon getPokemon(int position)
      Gets the pokemon in the array pokemonSquad at the written position.
      Parameters:
      position - It must be between 0 and 2, as the array containts 3 pokémon.
      Returns:
      The pokémon set in the array at the determined position, NOT the pokémon that is currently in battle.

    • setPokemonSquad

      public void setPokemonSquad(String pokemonName, int pokemonPosition)
      Sets one of the pokemon that the player will have while in battle, based on the written position, which have to be a number between 0 and 2, as the squad is made of 3 pokemon. The pokemon name must be one of the pokemon listed in the createPokemon(String) method. For the creation of the pokemon to then put in the squad this setter uses the createPokemon(String) method, located inside the Pokemon class. See it for more information about it.
      Parameters:
      pokemonName -
      pokemonPosition -

    • reversePlayer

      public static Player reversePlayer(Player p)
      A method which reverse the player currently active during a turn or a damage calculus. It can be useful when you don't know which of the player is the first to act during a turn, as it is determined by their current pokemon speed.
      Parameters:
      p -
      Returns:
      The other player, based on which player is inserted as the argument.
